# discord Provider

Manage durable Discord configuration through the Discord REST API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    discord = {
      source = "alpaca744/discord"
    }
  }
}

provider "discord" {
  # bot_token may also be supplied via the DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN environment variable.
  bot_token = var.discord_bot_token
}

variable "discord_bot_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_base_url` (String) Discord API base URL. Defaults to `https://discord.com/api/v10`. Falls back to `DISCORD_API_BASE_URL`.
- `bearer_token` (String, Sensitive) OAuth2 bearer token, required only for endpoints Discord restricts to OAuth (e.g. application command permissions). Falls back to `DISCORD_BEARER_TOKEN`.
- `bot_token` (String, Sensitive) Discord bot token. Primary authentication for guild/server management. Falls back to `DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN`.
- `client_id` (String) OAuth2 client ID. Falls back to `DISCORD_CLIENT_ID`.
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) OAuth2 client secret. Falls back to `DISCORD_CLIENT_SECRET`.
- `default_audit_log_reason` (String) Default `X-Audit-Log-Reason` sent with audited actions. Falls back to `DISCORD_AUDIT_LOG_REASON`.
